stages.discovery: Signs of a struggle litter this stretch of road - whatever happened here happened fast and wasn't survived by everyone involved. What's left standing changes with the telling, but the story underneath it never does: someone didn't make it past this point.

choices.label: Search the Wreckage
choices.description: Whoever did this left in a hurry too - Perception check

check.success_outcome: You pick through what's left, careful of the parts you'd rather not look at directly. Not everything of value was taken - some of it was overlooked in the rush, some of it wasn't worth the trouble to whoever won.
check.failure_outcome: You search what's left but whoever did this, or whoever came after, already took everything worth finding.

choices.label: Read the Scene
choices.description: Figure out what actually happened here - Investigation check

check.success_outcome: The marks in the dirt tell a clearer story than you wanted: an ambush, planned rather than opportunistic, sprung by someone who knew exactly when this road would be traveled. That kind of knowledge doesn't come cheap, or by accident.
check.failure_outcome: Too many feet and hooves have churned the ground since - whatever story it told originally, it's been trampled past reading now.

choices.label: Move Along Quickly
choices.description: ESC also cancels - whoever did this might not be far
choices.outcome: You don't linger long enough to learn more than you already have, and put the scene behind you at a brisk pace.
